title: Potara
tagline: This is the ICP Extension for 1inch's Fusion+. It enables atomic swap and partial fills
description:
This is the ICP><EVM implementation for 1inch's Fusion+. 
This is the first intent-based DEX on the ICP network, integrating the 1inch Fusion SDK.
Since the ICP version is different from EVM, many code logic workarounds need to be done to achieve the same goal
https://youtu.be/zL30HPduRlk
how_its_made:
Create a hashlock & timelock escrow contract on icp, handle secret bytes32 in icp using the b3_utils crate. 
Implement the ICP Resolver server to deploy the bytecode using `dfx canister`  command
We will create a sleek UI in the future to attract real users to this platform.
https://youtu.be/zL30HPduRlk
